name: Sehne
prior: Live waveguide/modal strings with damper, position and bow are mainstream: Ableton Tension / AAS String Studio (Damper Mass+Stiff+Position, Excitator Plectrum/Bow/Hammer with Position, Pickup Position, Inharm) [VS: ableton.com/packs/tension]; Logic Sculpture (Bow/Pick/Blow objects, damping, pickups) [A]; Mutable Rings string mode (damping, position live) [A]; GeoShred (JOS/CCRMA modeled guitar, 'modeled feedback', finger vibrato and slide, pressure dynamics, touch surface; GeoShred Studio $50 macOS, iOS app) [VS: kvraudio.com/product/geoshred-studio-for-mac-by-moforte; moforte.com]; MechanOdd (open-source VST3/AU, lossy dispersive 1D waveguide string, feedback matrix) [VS: github.com/odoare/MechanOdd]; Boing2 (free bowed dispersive waveguide) [VS: plugins4free.com/plugin/317]; StringLab iOS (Karplus-Strong, feedback damping) [VS: apps.apple.com/us/app/stringlab/id6461312318]; Faust pm.lib electric-guitar 'mute' input [VS: faustlibraries.grame.fr/libs/physmodels]; JOS: finger losses as reflection filter at a node [VS: ccrma.stanford.edu/~jos/BowedStrings]. Not found anywhere as a feature: a finger-node junction that produces natural harmonics (flageolet) physically, and the one-axis hand mapping palm-mute -> open -> flageolet -> E-Bow. Those two are the only uncommon parts. In Myzel: Saite = offline KS buffer, no glide, no live damping [APP 3704-3731].
costNotes: Waveguide archetype measured 0.24 units incl. node (lerp delay + 1-pole + allpass) [R: webaudio.md s4]. Sehne has 4 delay reads (v+/v- x 2 segments) with Lagrange-3 (4 MAC each), 2 dispersion allpasses, bridge 1-pole, junction, plus E-Bow path (tanh table + biquad bandpass ~30 ns [R s4]) = roughly 50-60 ns/sample = 0.45-0.5 units of DSP; + node 0.06 + 3-4 k-rate params 0.09-0.12 [R s4]. L1 ~0.6 (idea 0.45 is ~25% optimistic; 0.5 if the E-Bow bandpass is skipped while g_eb = 0). L3: 2 strings + 2 body resonators + stereo write ~1.1-1.2. Phone factor x1.0-1.5 applies to the unit itself [R s4]. Per-sample delay-target interpolation for glides is ~2 ns, not a cost issue. Allocate both delay lines at the lowest f (e.g. 20 Hz = 2400 samples per direction) in the constructor; no allocation in process().
soundHeld: A held finger at mid height is just a decaying pluck - identical in character to Saite. Held identity exists only in three places: slides (column changes glide the delay length; this is the GeoShred feel and is genuinely missing in Myzel), palm-damping that changes while the finger moves, and the E-Bow zone, where a dying pluck blooms back into an endless tone. The flageolet junction is physically right (modes with a node at x_f survive) but weak: at x_f = 1/2 only even harmonics remain and their energy depends on the pluck position - a pluck at a harmonic node makes the harmonic silent. Pluck near the bridge (pos <= 0.2) in the flageolet zone and expect 10-15 dB less level than the open string -> per-zone gain compensation. E-Bow: loop gain > 1 through tanh gives a sustained tone whose spectrum narrows to the bandpass centre - musically a 'sine with string noise'; the 2f switch above y 0.95 is the one surprise. Bebung via detune is clean (delay modulation).
soundBurst: Good: pluck + gate-damp = live palm-mute bass, which Saite cannot do (its damping is baked into the buffer). Short gates cut the string physically (the bridge keeps ringing briefly) -> organic 'chk' instead of an envelope click. Failure: fast Puls lanes with E-Bow Hoehe (y > 0.85) never decay -> the voice becomes a drone until stolen; clamp the Puls path to y <= 0.8 or make E-Bow gate-released. Repeated identical plucks sound mechanical -> 1 period of filtered noise with per-hit random seed and pick-position jitter of +-3%.
failureModes: Twin of Saite: at mid height a held or struck Sehne is indistinguishable from Saite; the library must present Sehne as 'lebendig' (glide, Hand, E-Bow) and Saite as 'viele Stimmen'
Flageolet level drop (10-15 dB) and silent harmonics when pluck position coincides with the harmonic node; needs pos clamp + zone gain
Delay-length change per block -> 2.7 ms pitch steps on fast slides; interpolate the delay target per sample (planned)

Fractional delay below ~1 period at high f with Lagrange-3: a 2-segment string at f > 3 kHz has < 8 samples per segment -> interpolation error, wrong tuning; cap f at ~2.5 kHz or fall back to a 1-segment model there
E-Bow + flageolet both active (0.85 boundary crossed with vibrato) -> mode jump and level jump; hysteresis on the zone boundary + RMS cap
Loop gain > 1 with tanh is a limit cycle, not a string: E-Bow drones all converge to the same timbre; add bandpass Q tied to vel and a slow random walk on the bandpass centre
Cost 0.6 not 0.45; worklet thread move is permanent once the module loads [R s2]
verdict: Common: live waveguide strings with damper position, bow and pickup are standard in Tension/String Studio, Sculpture, Rings and GeoShred, so Sehne will not make waves on its own; only the physical flageolet junction and the one-axis hand mapping are unusual. Feasible as a worklet at about 0.6 units (1.2 at level 3), a quarter above the idea's estimate. Musically it earns its place because Myzel has no live string at all (slides, live palm mute, E-Bow bloom), but at mid height it is a twin of Saite and the flageolet zone is quiet and position-sensitive. Keep it, build it as the shared myzel-string processor other string ideas can reuse, and sell it on glide, Hand and E-Bow, not on being a string.
